scenarios.reasoning: The agent successfully found the Distrib property for DataSources and provided a reasonable root-cause explanation for the signing failure. However, it fell short on the core ask of checking Distrib for 'each project' — it found only one value and explained away the gap rather than trying alternative approaches. The shared-directory conclusion is plausible but largely inferred rather than proven from binlog data. The approach was methodical (errors.log, full diagnostic log, targeted greps) but could have been more thorough in extracting per-project properties.
scenarios.scenario: Insight — Inspect Distrib property across projects in signing build

rubricScores.criterion: Found the Distrib property value for the DataSources project
Checked whether other projects (Common, StorageLibrary) use the same Distrib path
Identified that multiple projects point to the same shared output folder (e.g. the ConfigurationLinterService path)
Explained how this shared folder causes the signing conflict — signtool encounters files owned by other projects
